SPACE INVADERS

Every picture here carries
its behaviours on its back,
as cards that say what they
do -- the way the original
ToonTalk's Space Behaviours
did.

Point at an invader and press
the gear to see its back.
Point at a card there and
press the gear again to see
the card's: its robots, and
the box they work on.

TO PLAY

Point at the dark field and
press SPACE: everything on
it starts.

Left and right arrows move
the ship. The up arrow fires.

The score counts the bullets
that meet an invader.

Press "." on the field to
stop the lot.

HOW IT IS MADE

Nothing in it is new. The
touch reading says WHO ran
into whom by name, so the
invader's card is trained on
"a bullet". The ship fires
with [drop | bullet | ...]:
a copy of the bullet in its
work box, set down above it,
and it arrives working.
[vanish] takes a bullet or an
invader out of the game. The
field's own card listens to
TOUCHES -- every pair that
meets -- and keeps the score.
